Overview.Name: Naresh Rathod
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Meal_1: Option 1: 2 boiled eggs + any 1 fruit (apple, banana, orange or papaya)
Option 2: Paneer cubes (100 g, lightly pan cooked) + any 1 fruit
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (1 bowl ~150 g) + curd (small bowl)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & vegetable curry & curd (200 g)
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (100 g, low oil) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (100 g, boiled/light) & vegetable curry
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & curd (200 g) & cucumber salad + any 1 fruit
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer cubes (80 g, low oil) & vegetable curry + any 1 fruit
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg omelette (2 eggs) + any 1 fruit

Notes_and_Tips: Keep cooking low oil or boiled as much as possible.
Start meals with paneer, eggs or curd before eating rice to control overeating.
For stress eating, pause 10 minutes after starting a meal before taking more food.
Avoid deep fried and outside spicy foods.
Simple consistent meals will support steady fat loss and better energy.
